tasks.title: Compound Rotated Packet with Dual 3D Wings
tasks.instruction: The paper is prepared through printed step 2 (folded in half then quarter flap folded up). Follow the diagram: reopen the bottom flap, reverse fold the top and bottom layers in opposing directions, rotate paper 90 degrees, partially unfold the bottom wing to 90 degrees standing in 3D, turn the paper over across the vertical axis, partially unfold the other wing to 90 degrees standing in 3D, and rotate paper 90 degrees to finalize the 3D compound structure.

tasks.title: Dual-Rotated Pleated Packet with Dual 3D Wings
tasks.instruction: The paper is prepared through printed step 3 (folded in half, top flap folded toward, bottom flap folded away). Follow the printed diagram: unfold both flaps, rotate paper 90 degrees, create a two-way pleat along the new quarter crease, turn the paper over across the vertical axis, partially unfold the upper wing to 90 degrees standing in 3D, rotate paper 90 degrees, partially unfold the opposing wing to 90 degrees standing in 3D, and rotate paper 90 degrees to lock the 3D compound structure.

tasks.title: Drinking Cup
tasks.instruction: Follow the printed diagram to fold a drinking cup. Start with the diagonal fold, fold side corners to opposite edges, fold the front top flap down over the front, turn over, and fold the back top flap down over the back.

tasks.title: Fortune Teller
tasks.instruction: Follow printed steps 1 through 3: pre-crease both diagonals and open, fold all four corners into the centre point, turn over, and fold all four corners into the centre point again.
